tools.name: lint_skill
tools.description: Vet a SKILL.md before you install it: structure, trigger quality, leaked secrets, prompt-injection markers, broken links and autonomy claims. Returns a verdict, a score and a sha256 of the checked file.

tools.name: compare_skills
tools.description: Compare candidate skills from different registries and rank them by verdict and evidence quality. Takes a comma-separated list of paths.

tools.name: lint_rules
tools.description: List the linter's rules with their identifiers and severity levels.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "lint_skill" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Vet a SKILL.md before you install it: structure, trigger quality, leaked secrets, prompt-injection markers, broken links and autonomy claims. Returns a verdict,…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lint_skill" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
